wlbHistory: Sample history. Wildcat well 15/9-X1 was drilled to TD at 3400 m. Lost circulation was experienced at 2310 m in the Shetland Group chalk. The losses were cured with LCM pills. A gas kick was taken at 1960 m in the Lista Formation; the well was shut in and killed with 1.45 g/cm3 mud.
Sample history. The well was drilled without significant problems to 3300 m.
Sample history. The drill string became stuck at 1180 m in the Hordaland Group due to swelling clay. The pipe was jarred free after 14 hours.
